comparisonScope: The paired records below apply to both zh and en internal author intent/key/rationales/coverage. They compare newly disclosed evidence with phase1, not re-solve the visible questions. Every option ID has matching truth and a checked derivation; each false option's stated misconception generates the actual false claim or expression.

Author separates scattering toward the eye from detection threshold, matching phase1's conditional visibility statement.
